answer: Every claim climbs the sonnet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jade re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
